facts.business: Gaekwar Mills Limited was engaged in manufacturing fabrics but the unit was declared sick; currently the company has no business operations and is focused on developing 60% of its own land at Bilimora, Gujarat for infrastructure/commercial development.
key_risks: Workers have filed cases against the Company in High Court of Maharashtra and Gujarat preventing new business start
Company lacks expertise in construction activity
Low population in Bilimora area to consume constructed units
Company is currently in loss with no business operations
